detailed_descriptions.en: Print and Sell Books! Start with a single, slow printer with a tiny bookshelf and work your way towards making the most profitable Bookstore in the world! Explore Hundreds of Upgrades! From different book types to new customers, staff members, coffee machine, bus stops and much more! Manage the Chaos! Watch out for pesky thieves, customers creating a mess, reporters offering exposure for a price... And your never-ending cashier queue! Features: - A short 5-6h active incremental game where almost everything can be Upgraded! - Start with one tiny shelf and progressively expand your Bookstore! - Massive Skill Tree with 500+ Upgrade Nodes and 2700+ Total Upgrades! - No Fixed Upgrade Paths - there are always many options for you to choose! - Dynamic weather that affects your store in different ways! - You can even Upgrade your Upgrade Nodes to Unlock even More Upgrades! - New Game+ allows you to endlessly replay the game with a permanent +20% Income bonus per completion!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Print and Sell Books!

Start with a single, slow printer with a tiny bookshelf and work your way towards making the most profitable Bookstore in the world!

Explore Hundreds of Upgrades!

From different book types to new customers, staff members, coffee machine, bus stops and much more!

Manage the Chaos!

Watch out for pesky thieves, customers creating a mess, reporters offering exposure for a price... And your never-ending cashier queue!

Features:

- A short 5-6h active incremental game where almost everything can be Upgraded!

- Start with one tiny shelf and progressively expand your Bookstore!

- Massive Skill Tree with 500+ Upgrade Nodes and 2700+ Total Upgrades!

- No Fixed Upgrade Paths - there are always many options for you to choose!

- Dynamic weather that affects your store in different ways!

- You can even Upgrade your Upgrade Nodes to Unlock even More Upgrades!

- New Game+ allows you to endlessly replay the game with a permanent +20% Income bonus per completion!
